question: How is the sadashiva day and great-dissolution night reckoned?
premises: lordly time is multiplied by half-counts
sadayiva day and great dissolution night follow
inference: The sadashiva day and great-dissolution night are reckoned by the same multiplied time.
plain_english: Multiplying the lordly time by half-counts and by a hundred gives the sadashiva day; the night is the great dissolution.
